class.name: SpacetimeDBBSATN
class.brief_description: Utility class for SpacetimeDB BSATN binary serialization.
class.description: SpacetimeDBBSATN provides static helper methods for encoding and decoding data in SpacetimeDB's Binary Serialization and Algebraic Type Notation (BSATN) format. All multi-byte integers are little-endian. Strings and byte arrays are prefixed with a u32 length.

method.name: encode_bool
method.description: Encodes a boolean as 1 byte (0 or 1).

method.name: encode_u32
method.description: Encodes an unsigned 32-bit integer in little-endian.

method.name: encode_i64
method.description: Encodes a signed 64-bit integer in little-endian.

method.name: encode_string
method.description: Encodes a UTF-8 string with a u32 length prefix.

method.name: encode_bytes
method.description: Encodes raw bytes with a u32 length prefix.

method.name: encode_variant
method.description: Encodes a Variant using automatic BSATN type mapping.

method.name: decode_bool
method.description: Decodes a boolean from a byte at the given offset.

method.name: decode_u32
method.description: Decodes an unsigned 32-bit integer from the given offset.

method.name: decode_i64
method.description: Decodes a signed 64-bit integer from the given offset.

method.name: decode_f64
method.description: Decodes a 64-bit float from the given offset.

method.name: decode_string
method.description: Decodes a length-prefixed UTF-8 string from the given offset.

method.name: decode_bytes
method.description: Decodes a length-prefixed byte array from the given offset.

method.name: string_byte_length
method.description: Returns the total byte length of a BSATN-encoded string (4-byte prefix + payload).
